lines.zh: 三叶虫贴着水底缓慢爬行
lines.en: The trilobite creeps along the lakebed.

lines.zh: 它用一排细腿推动身体
lines.en: Rows of small legs push it forward.

lines.zh: 甲壳在沙上划出浅浅的沟
lines.en: Its shell cuts a shallow groove in sand.

lines.zh: 它绕着水草根部挪动
lines.en: It works its way around a clump of weeds.

lines.zh: 每一节体节都跟着扭一下
lines.en: Each body segment twists in turn.

lines.zh: 它爬过卵石，翻了半个身
lines.en: It clambers over a pebble and half rolls.

lines.zh: 泥面上留下一串细密足印
lines.en: A line of tiny tracks marks the silt.

lines.zh: 它一头钻进软泥里又钻出来
lines.en: It burrows into soft mud and re-emerges.

lines.zh: 它边走边用触须探路
lines.en: Antennae feel the way ahead as it goes.

lines.zh: 水流推它一下，它稳住身子
lines.en: A current nudges it; it holds firm.

lines.zh: 它沿着石缝一路向深处去
lines.en: It follows a rock crevice deeper down.

lines.zh: 壳缘轻轻刮过木头的表面
lines.en: Its shell edge grazes a sunken log.

lines.zh: 它绕过沉木，换个方向爬
lines.en: It rounds the sunken log and changes course.

lines.zh: 一群细腿像波浪一样摆动
lines.en: Its many legs ripple like a wave.

lines.zh: 它贴着水底，从不浮起来
lines.en: It hugs the bottom and never rises.

lines.zh: 水波晃着它的影子
lines.en: Ripples rock its small shadow.

lines.zh: 它爬到石头上，又滑下去
lines.en: It climbs a stone and slides back down.

lines.zh: 它慢得像一块会动的石子
lines.en: It moves like a pebble that happens to crawl.

lines.zh: 三叶虫伏在泥上，一动不动
lines.en: The trilobite lies still on the silt.

lines.zh: 它把身体蜷成一个半圆
lines.en: It curls its body into a half circle.

lines.zh: 复眼在浑水里反射微光
lines.en: Its compound eyes glint in the murk.

lines.zh: 它缩起足肢，只留壳在外
lines.en: It tucks its legs in, shell exposed.

lines.zh: 水流拂过甲壳，带走泥沙
lines.en: Current washes the silt off its shell.

lines.zh: 它缓缓舒展，又蜷回去
lines.en: It slowly uncurls, then curls again.

lines.zh: 一小片水草落在它背上
lines.en: A scrap of weed settles on its back.

lines.zh: 它用触须敲了敲前面的石子
lines.en: An antenna taps the stone ahead.

lines.zh: 它的鳃在壳下轻轻扇动
lines.en: Gills flutter gently beneath the shell.

lines.zh: 它像是从岩层里长出来的
lines.en: It looks grown out of the rock itself.

lines.zh: 一只小鱼擦过它，它不动
lines.en: A small fish brushes by; it does not stir.

lines.zh: 壳上的纵沟被光照得很清楚
lines.en: Light picks out the ridges of its shell.

lines.zh: 它偶尔颤一下尾节
lines.en: Its tail segment twitches now and then.

lines.zh: 它把自己埋进沙里大半
lines.en: It sinks most of the way into the sand.

lines.zh: 气泡从壳边慢慢冒上去
lines.en: Bubbles drift up from its shell edge.

lines.zh: 古旧得像是活着的化石
lines.en: It lies there, a fossil still alive.

lines.zh: 三叶虫抬起小小的复眼
lines.en: The trilobite lifts its tiny eyes.

lines.zh: 它分辨不出你，只是停下
lines.en: It cannot make you out, so it stops.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了整块水底
lines.en: Your shadow covers the whole lakebed.

lines.zh: 它往泥里缩了一点
lines.en: It sinks a little deeper into the mud.

lines.zh: 触须朝你的方向试探
lines.en: An antenna probes toward you.

lines.zh: 它对你的靴子更感兴趣
lines.en: It seems more interested in your boot.

lines.zh: 它慢慢转身，正对着你
lines.en: It turns slowly to face you squarely.

lines.zh: 一个小小的注视，没有敌意
lines.en: A small, unhostile stare.

lines.zh: 它在你脚边绕行了一圈
lines.en: It circles once at your feet.

lines.zh: 壳在水下泛出暗褐的光
lines.en: Its shell gives a dull brown gleam.

lines.zh: 它从你影子里慢慢爬开
lines.en: It crawls slowly out of your shadow.

lines.zh: 它抬头看你，像看一块石头
lines.en: It looks up at you as at a boulder.

lines.zh: 三叶虫受惊，立刻蜷起来
lines.en: Startled, the trilobite curls up at once.

lines.zh: 它翻过去，急匆匆地爬走
lines.en: It flips over and scrambles away.

lines.zh: 壳上多了一道白痕
lines.en: A white score appears on its shell.

lines.zh: 它把软腹缩得更深
lines.en: It pulls its soft belly deeper in.

lines.zh: 细腿乱蹬，它慌得厉害
lines.en: Its legs flail in panic.

lines.zh: 它装死，一动不动
lines.en: It plays dead and does not move.

lines.zh: 水流把它冲得歪了半寸
lines.en: The current knocks it half an inch off course.

lines.zh: 它躲进沙里只留个壳顶
lines.en: It hides in the sand, shell top only.

lines.zh: 它受伤后更谨慎了
lines.en: Wounded, it grows more careful.

lines.zh: 这点小伤对它也算大
lines.en: For something this small, even this is much.

lines.zh: 三叶虫朝食物的气味爬来
lines.en: The trilobite crawls toward the scent.

lines.zh: 它触须乱摆，显然很急
lines.en: Its antennae wave; it is clearly eager.

lines.zh: 一点点碎肉就让它加速
lines.en: A scrap of flesh speeds it up.

lines.zh: 它爬到食物上，先探再咬
lines.en: It reaches the food, feels it, then bites.

lines.zh: 它用前足把食物拢到口边
lines.en: Front legs rake the food to its mouth.

lines.zh: 它埋头啃着，速度快了许多
lines.en: Head down, it eats far faster now.

lines.zh: 吃到一半，它警觉地停住
lines.en: Halfway through, it freezes warily.

lines.zh: 它把剩下的拖进石缝
lines.en: It drags the rest into a crevice.

lines.zh: 吃饱后它慢慢退回泥里
lines.en: Sated, it backs slowly into the mud.

lines.zh: 它还在找刚才那点味道
lines.en: It is still hunting that last trace of taste.

lines.zh: 它沿着气味绕了三个圈
lines.en: It circles the scent three times.

lines.zh: 它把嘴边的沙也一起吞了
lines.en: It swallows a mouthful of sand with it.

lines.zh: 触须抖得很欢，像在庆祝
lines.en: Its antennae flutter as if celebrating.

lines.zh: 肚子鼓起来，它爬得慢了
lines.en: Its belly swells and its crawl slows.

lines.zh: 它守着这点残渣不肯走
lines.en: It guards the scraps and will not leave.

lines.zh: 一点食物，就够它忙半天
lines.en: One scrap is half a day's work for it.

lines.zh: 你挪脚时碰到了三叶虫
lines.en: Your foot nudges the trilobite.

lines.zh: 它被推得翻了个壳朝天
lines.en: The push tips it onto its back.

lines.zh: 它急忙翻身，重新趴好
lines.en: It rights itself hurriedly.

lines.zh: 它蜷成一团，滚到一边
lines.en: It curls and rolls aside.

lines.zh: 壳撞在你靴尖上，发出轻响
lines.en: Its shell taps your boot toe.

lines.zh: 它从你鞋边挤过去
lines.en: It squeezes past the edge of your shoe.

lines.zh: 它被水流带着撞上你的腿
lines.en: Carried by current, it bumps your leg.

lines.zh: 碰撞后它缩起来装死
lines.en: After the bump it curls up and plays dead.

lines.zh: 它退进沙里，只露出眼
lines.en: It backs into the sand, eyes only.

lines.zh: 小小一撞，它却记了很久
lines.en: A tiny knock, but it stays spooked a while.

lines.zh: 两只三叶虫壳缘贴在一起
lines.en: Two trilobites press shell edge to shell.

lines.zh: 它们用触须互相轻敲
lines.en: They tap each other with their antennae.

lines.zh: 它们并排钻进同一片软泥
lines.en: They burrow side by side into soft mud.

lines.zh: 尾部相碰，是一种应答
lines.en: Tail meets tail in quiet answer.

lines.zh: 它们绕着彼此慢慢打转
lines.en: They circle each other slowly.

lines.zh: 一只替另一只清理壳缝
lines.en: One cleans the other's shell seams.

lines.zh: 它们蜷成两个紧挨的半圆
lines.en: They curl into two adjoining half moons.

lines.zh: 水底安静得只剩细腿声
lines.en: Only tiny legs sound on the lakebed.

lines.zh: 它们把头节对在一起
lines.en: They set their head shields together.

lines.zh: 这对古老的生物从不急躁
lines.en: These ancient creatures are never hurried.

lines.zh: 三叶虫拖走一块碎肉
lines.en: The trilobite drags off a scrap of meat.

lines.zh: 它把食物压在壳底下
lines.en: It pins the food beneath its shell.

lines.zh: 它用后腿蹬着东西往后拖
lines.en: Hind legs shove it backwards with the prize.

lines.zh: 它把东西藏进石缝深处
lines.en: It hides the item deep in a crevice.

lines.zh: 它一边啃一边用触须警戒
lines.en: It eats with antennae on watch.

lines.zh: 它把沉下的碎屑都扫到自己面前
lines.en: It sweeps the settling crumbs to itself.

lines.zh: 它咬住不放，你拉不动
lines.en: It clamps on; you cannot tug it loose.

lines.zh: 它把东西拱进泥沙里埋好
lines.en: It bulldozes the item into the silt.

lines.zh: 它拖着比自己大的东西走
lines.en: It hauls something bigger than itself.

lines.zh: 吃完它舔干净前足
lines.en: Afterward it licks its front legs clean.

lines.zh: 三叶虫忽然转向了你
lines.en: The trilobite suddenly turns your way.

lines.zh: 它抬起前节，像在判断
lines.en: It lifts its front segment as if judging.

lines.zh: 触须伸得笔直，指向你
lines.en: Its antennae point straight at you.

lines.zh: 它把你当成一块可食的残余
lines.en: It takes you for edible leftovers.

lines.zh: 小小的颚开始张合
lines.en: Its small jaws begin to work.

lines.zh: 它加速爬来，毫不犹豫
lines.en: It scuttles in without hesitation.

lines.zh: 它攀上你的鞋面
lines.en: It climbs onto your shoe.

lines.zh: 这个化石般的东西竟然好斗
lines.en: Something so fossil-like turns out hostile.

lines.zh: 它顺着水声锁定了你
lines.en: It locks on to the sound you make.

lines.zh: 我卷成一颗石球，藏在志留纪的泥里。
lines.en: I roll into a stone ball in Silurian mud.

lines.zh: 三叶虫贴着你脚边绕圈
lines.en: The trilobite circles at your ankles.

lines.zh: 它找你的脚踝下手
lines.en: It goes for your ankles.

lines.zh: 它一点点逼近，不着急
lines.en: It closes in, unhurried.

lines.zh: 你一动，它立刻跟上
lines.en: Move, and it follows at once.

lines.zh: 它爬到石头上，占了高处
lines.en: It climbs a stone for the high ground.

lines.zh: 它用触须不断试探距离
lines.en: Its antennae measure the gap again and again.

lines.zh: 它在等你的脚落下来
lines.en: It waits for your foot to come down.

lines.zh: 它绕到你身后去了
lines.en: It has slipped behind you.

lines.zh: 小小的影子一直跟着你
lines.en: A tiny shadow keeps pace with you.

lines.zh: 它开始啃你的靴底
lines.en: It starts gnawing your boot sole.

lines.zh: 三叶虫一口咬在你的脚踝
lines.en: The trilobite bites your ankle.

lines.zh: 它的颚撕下一小片皮
lines.en: Its jaws tear off a small strip of skin.

lines.zh: 它爬上小腿，继续咬
lines.en: It climbs your calf and bites again.

lines.zh: 它整个身子撞过来
lines.en: It hurls its whole body at you.

lines.zh: 壳缘刮过你的皮肤
lines.en: Its shell edge scrapes your skin.

lines.zh: 咬完它迅速缩回泥里
lines.en: It bites, then darts back into the mud.

lines.zh: 它咬住不放，用力扭
lines.en: It clamps down and twists.

lines.zh: 它试了第二次，劲更狠
lines.en: Its second bite lands harder.

lines.zh: 它从你脚背上滑下来
lines.en: It slides off the top of your foot.

lines.zh: 它的小颚咬得很固执
lines.en: Those tiny jaws bite with stubborn force.

lines.zh: 水底的泥面鼓起一小堆
lines.en: A small mound swells on the lakebed.

lines.zh: 一只三叶虫从沙里拱出来
lines.en: A trilobite pushes up out of the sand.

lines.zh: 它的壳先露出水面下的光
lines.en: Its shell surfaces first as a gleam.

lines.zh: 细腿拨开淤泥的动静很轻
lines.en: Tiny legs part the silt quietly.

lines.zh: 它从石缝里慢慢挤出身体
lines.en: It squeezes out of a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 水草晃了一下，它出现了
lines.en: The weeds sway, and there it is.

lines.zh: 它身上还挂着湿泥
lines.en: Wet mud still clings to its shell.

lines.zh: 一队三叶虫沿着沟槽爬来
lines.en: A line of trilobites files along a groove.

lines.zh: 它停在水底，先探了探路
lines.en: It stops and feels the way first.

lines.zh: 古老的甲壳在浅水里发暗
lines.en: An ancient shell darkens the shallows.

lines.zh: 它爬过你脚边的浅滩
lines.en: It crawls across the shallows by your feet.

lines.zh: 水底多了一个会动的石子
lines.en: The lakebed has gained a moving pebble.

lines.zh: 壳被烫得一缩，它拼命往泥里钻
lines.en: Heat shrinks its shell; it drills into the mud.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，它的壳磕出闷响
lines.en: It hits the ground with a dull shell knock.

lines.zh: 它被水困住，足肢乱抓
lines.en: Trapped in water, its legs claw wildly.

lines.zh: 冲击把三叶虫掀了几个跟头
lines.en: The blast tumbles it over and over.

lines.zh: 箭尖钉在壳边，它整个僵住
lines.en: An arrowhead pins its shell rim; it goes rigid.

lines.zh: 魔法渗进甲壳，它不停发抖
lines.en: Magic seeps into the shell and it shivers.

lines.zh: 饿得壳都轻了，它爬得很慢
lines.en: Starved thin, it crawls very slowly.

lines.zh: 电光穿过水，它蜷得死紧
lines.en: Lightning crosses the water; it curls up tight.

lines.zh: 它被虚空吸住，细腿徒劳划动
lines.en: The void takes hold; its legs paddle uselessly.
